item.title: DC Studios Moves ‘Clayface’ to October 2026, Warner Bros. Shifts ‘Practical Magic 2’ Release Date

item.title: ‘Closure’ Review: In This Sundance Stunner, a Missing Person Mystery Becomes a Devastating Study of Love and Loss
item.description: Filmmaker Michał Marczak carves out a unique space for his documentary “Closure” within the non-fiction world. item.title: Harman Baweja, Arati Kadav Reunite for New Project After ‘Mrs.’ (EXCLUSIVE)
item.description: Producer Harman Baweja and director Arati Kadav are teaming up for a new film, marking their second collaboration following last year’s critically acclaimed drama “Mrs.” The duo unveiled their reunion timed to coincide with the one-year anniversary of “Mrs.,” the Sanya Malhotra-starrer that became a cultural touchpoint for its exploration of domestic identity and gender […]

item.title: Ludwig Göransson and EJAE Lead Society of Composers and Lyricists Awards Winners
item.description: “Sinners” composer Ludwig Göransson and “KPop Demon Hunters” singer and songwriter EJAE led the winners at the 7th annual Society of Composers and Lyricists awards. Göransson took home two SCL Awards for his “Sinners” score and the original song “I Lied to You,” co-written with Raphael Saadiq.
